title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Reset Your Password
content:
To reset your CultPass password:

1. Open the CultPass app or visit the website
2. Tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
3. Enter your registered email address
4. Check your email inbox (and spam/junk folder) for the reset link
5. The reset link expires after 30 minutes — request a new one if needed
6. Create a new password with at least 8 characters, including a number and a special character

If you no longer have access to your registered email, contact support for identity verification.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To reset your password, tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen and follow the link sent to your email. The link is valid for 30 minutes."

title: Subscription Billing Dates and Charges Explained
content:
CultPass subscriptions are billed monthly on the same date the subscription was activated.

Key billing facts:
- Charges appear as 'CULTPASS SUBSCRIPTION' on your bank statement
- You'll receive an email receipt after each charge
- If a charge fails, you'll have 3 days to update your payment before the subscription is suspended
- Billing continues until you cancel — pausing does NOT stop billing
- Annual plans are charged once upfront and offer a 20% discount

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You are billed monthly on your subscription anniversary date. Billing only stops after you cancel — pausing your plan keeps your account active but does not halt charges."
tags: billing, charges, payment, subscription, invoice, receipt

title: How to Update Your Profile and Contact Details
content:
To update your CultPass profile information:

1. Open the CultPass app
2. Go to 'My Account' > 'Edit Profile'
3. You can change: display name, phone number, and notification preferences
4. Email changes require verification — a link will be sent to the new address
5. Profile photo can be updated from the same screen

Note: Changing your email will log you out of all devices for security.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your profile in the 'My Account' section. Email changes require verification via a link sent to your new address."
tags: profile, account, email, update, contact, settings

title: What Happens When Your Account is Blocked
content:
A CultPass account may be blocked for the following reasons:
- Violation of CultPass Terms of Service
- Fraudulent activity or chargebacks
- Multiple failed payment attempts
- Identity verification failure

If your account is blocked:
- You will not be able to make new reservations
- Existing reservations may be cancelled depending on the reason
- You will receive an email with the reason and next steps
- You can appeal by contacting support with your account ID

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Account blocks can happen due to policy violations or payment issues. Contact our support team with your account ID to appeal or resolve the block."
tags: blocked, account, access, violation, appeal, banned

title: Premium Experiences: Access and Requirements
content:
Premium experiences in CultPass require:

1. An active Premium or higher tier subscription
2. The experience must still have available slots
3. Reservations may require advance booking (up to 7 days prior)

Premium experience features:
- VIP access or priority entry
- Exclusive dates/times
- Limited capacity for a more intimate experience

Basic tier subscribers can purchase individual premium experiences at a one-time add-on price shown in the app.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Premium experiences are available to subscribers on the Premium tier. Basic subscribers can still access them individually for an add-on fee shown in the app."
tags: premium, experience, tier, vip, booking, access, subscription

title: CultPass Refund and Dispute Policy
content:
CultPass refund policy:

- Subscription fees are non-refundable once a billing cycle has started
- If an experience is cancelled by the venue, a credit is issued to your account (not a cash refund)
- Credits expire after 90 days
- Disputes must be submitted within 30 days of the charge
- To dispute a charge, go to 'My Account' > 'Billing' > 'Dispute a Charge'

Exceptions may apply at the discretion of the support lead.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Subscription charges are generally non-refundable. If an event is cancelled, you'll receive a credit. To dispute a charge, visit 'Billing' in your account settings."
tags: refund, dispute, billing, credit, charge, policy

title: How to Cancel an Experience Reservation
content:
To cancel a reservation:

1. Open the CultPass app
2. Go to 'My Reservations'
3. Select the reservation you want to cancel
4. Tap 'Cancel Reservation'
5. Confirm the cancellation

Cancellation rules:
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the event
- Cancellations within 24 hours forfeit the slot from your monthly quota
- Premium experience cancellations within 48 hours may incur a fee

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel a reservation in 'My Reservations' in the app. For free cancellation, do it at least 24 hours before the event."
tags: cancel, reservation, booking, refund, slot, event

title: Troubleshooting the CultPass Mobile App
content:
Common app issues and solutions:

**App crashes or won't open:**
- Force close and reopen the app
- Check for app updates in the App Store or Google Play
- Restart your device
- Uninstall and reinstall the app (your account data is cloud-synced)

**QR code not loading:**
- Ensure you have an active internet connection
- Try toggling airplane mode off/on
- Open the QR from the 'My Reservations' section

**Slow performance:**
- Clear the app cache in your device settings
- Ensure you have at least 500MB of free storage

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Most app issues can be resolved by updating or reinstalling the app — your account and reservations are safely stored in the cloud."
tags: app, crash, technical, qr, performance, troubleshoot, mobile

title: How to View Your Experience History
content:
To view past and upcoming experiences:

1. Open the CultPass app
2. Go to 'My Account' > 'Experience History'
3. Use the tabs to switch between 'Upcoming', 'Past', and 'Cancelled'

You can also:
- Download a PDF summary of your experience history
- Re-book a past experience if it's available again
- Rate and review experiences you've attended

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your full experience history is available in 'My Account' > 'Experience History'. You can view upcoming, past, and cancelled bookings there."
tags: history, reservations, past experiences, review, booking, account

title: Contacting CultPass Customer Support
content:
CultPass support is available through multiple channels:

- **In-app chat**: 'My Account' > 'Help & Support' (fastest response, Mon-Fri 9am-6pm)
- **Email**: support@cultpass.com (response within 24 hours)
- **UDA-Hub AI**: Available 24/7 for instant answers to common questions

When contacting support, have ready:
- Your account ID or registered email
- The description of your issue
- Screenshots if applicable

**Escalation**: Complex issues like billing disputes, blocked accounts, or lost data are prioritized and handled by senior agents.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"For urgent issues, use the in-app chat. For billing disputes or account blocks, our senior support team will follow up within 24 hours."
tags: support, contact, help, escalation, chat, email, customer service
